verdict_note: sparse (kc_frac_active ~0.05-0.15) and decodable (loo_nearest_centroid_acc >> chance) with APL = olfactory learning viable; APL ablation should raise frac_active if APL is sparsening; frac_active ~1 or ~0 at every threshold with decoding at chance = the rate model cannot code odours. The decoder is scored on held-out presentations; the earlier one-presentation nearest-neighbour test was identically 0 and is gone.
